name: Pinerolo (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pinerolo (a pine tree on white above black and white stripes) within branches, with the motto on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Pinerolo, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pinerolo arms — pine tree on white over black and white bars, crowned, with motto scroll
